about: Cards the deck census's band draw (tools/cubelab/deckcensus.ts, `decks --band`) never deals into a deck, because Forge's AI cannot finish their games inside the atlas's branch budget: an ENGINE limitation, measured, not a design judgement. A card goes here only with a measured stall (branches timed out inside one engine step with the card on the board). Read by the band census draw alone; never by `decks --cube`, the cube lab's drafts, the evolve loop or the board.

Scute Swarm.why: copies itself on every land drop, so boards reach 50-127 tokens and Forge's AI attack/block prediction iterates them for 1,000-1,300 s inside one event-free engine step that the branch deadline (D467) cannot see; 134 of spine s04's 135 timed-out branches had it on the battlefield (124 with 40+ copies), 14 unit kills, 0 on the other three spines

Chain of Smog.why: 'target player discards two cards; that player may copy this spell and choose a new target for the copy': with Forge's AI in both seats each copies it back at the other without end, so the engine runs 82,000-599,000 events (median 272,000) inside one step until the branch deadline (D467/D484) fires; 494 of spine s06's 2,925 branch games timed out (486 inside one step, 4 at a confirm or target callback, 4 with no error text), every one with it on the stack at the last state of a seat's log (492 in seat 0's, the other 2 in seat 1's), against a 1.3 s mean (0.85 s median) for the spine's other branches; 0 timeouts in the night's five other spines; the step ran past the runner's 10,800 s cap and failed the job
